【原视频简介】
Free Claude Code lets developers keep the Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or OpenCode workflow while routing coding-agent requests to free, cheaper, or fully local AI models instead of relying on Anthropic for every task. 

In this video, I install free-claude-code, set up the local proxy, connect a free model provider, launch Claude Code through it, and test it on real work to see how well file editing, tool calls, refactoring, and agentic coding actually hold up.
